scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names engine,ui,app --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @kratos/engine" "npm run dev -w @kratos/ui" "npm run dev -w @kratos/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kratos/ui && npm run build -w @kratos/engine && npm run build -w @kratos/desktop
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @kratos/desktop
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
